from typing import Iterable

def total_coverage(spans: Iterable[tuple[int, int]]) -> int:
    if not spans:
        return 0
    
    # Sort the spans by their start positions
    sorted_spans = sorted(spans, key=lambda span: span[0])
    
    # Initialize variables to track the current coverage and the end of the last covered span
    current_coverage = 0
    last_end = -1
    
    for start, end in sorted_spans:
        # Check if the current span overlaps with the last covered span
        if start <= last_end:
            # Update the current coverage to the maximum of the current coverage and the end of the last covered span
            current_coverage = max(current_coverage, last_end)
        else:
            # Update the current coverage to the end of the current span
            current_coverage = end
        # Update the last end to the end of the current span
        last_end = current_coverage
    
    return current_coverage
